name: Osmious-Bastion
description: The sea here is thick with dissolved metals, so sunsets burn green and gold above the waves. Beneath them wait perpetual storm systems, and everything the light never reaches.

Breathable air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything. Ambush predators lie beneath the thermally warm silt, patient as geology.
Nothing about the exotic matter deposit appears on any natural-phenomena registry. The leading research institutions classify it as 'pending,' which is science's word for afraid.
There is money in biomass here, and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
